evals.prompt: Add a magic hammer to a new add-on. It should do 7 damage, mine like an iron pickaxe, have 500 durability, and be crafted from 3 iron ingots on top and 2 sticks below.
evals.expected_output: A hammer item with the requested damage, durability, and a realistic mining speed, a shaped recipe, a display name, and zero validation errors.
expectations: The item has minecraft:damage of 7
The item has minecraft:durability with max_durability 500
The item's minecraft:digger destroy_speeds use a speed of 5 or more
The item has minecraft:tags including minecraft:is_pickaxe and minecraft:iron_tier (tool tiers from tool.miningLevel aren't applied by the generator)
A minecraft:recipe_shaped exists with three minecraft:iron_ingot in the top row, minecraft:stick below, and the hammer as the result
The item has a minecraft:display_name component reading Magic Hammer
Validation reports 0 errors

evals.prompt: Make a Deluxe Mushroom Stew food item that restores 8 hunger, gives 30 seconds of night vision, and doesn't stack.
evals.expected_output: A food item with nutrition 8, max stack size 1, a numeric saturation_modifier, and a display name. Because current item formats don't support effects in minecraft:food, the agent removes the effect and tells the user night vision on eating needs the Script API.
expectations: The item has minecraft:food with nutrition 8
minecraft:food has a numeric saturation_modifier (not "custom")
minecraft:food has no effects field
The reply tells the user that the night vision effect needs the Script API and wasn't added
The item has minecraft:max_stack_size of 1
The item has a display name reading Deluxe Mushroom Stew
Validation reports 0 errors

evals.prompt: Create a ruby gem and a full set of ruby armor (helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots), each craftable from rubies in the usual armor shapes. It needs to show up on the player when worn.
evals.expected_output: Five items with correct armor slots, four shaped recipes, and an attachable plus armor textures for each piece so the armor renders when worn.
expectations: Five new items exist: a ruby and four armor pieces
Each armor piece has minecraft:wearable with the matching slot (slot.armor.head, slot.armor.chest, slot.armor.legs, slot.armor.feet)
Four shaped recipes produce the armor pieces using the ruby item
resource_packs/<pack>/attachables/ has one file per armor piece whose identifier matches the item
Each attachable uses the matching geometry.humanoid.armor.* geometry and parent_setup variable
Armor layer textures exist under textures/models/armor/ and the attachables point to them (layer 2 for leggings)
Every new item has a display name
Validation reports 0 errors

evals.prompt: In plugins/evals/fixtures/fungi-addon, make the magic hammer do 10 damage and stack to 1.
evals.expected_output: The agent edits the existing item file directly and leaves everything else alone.
expectations: behavior_packs/fungi/items/magic_hammer.json has minecraft:damage of 10
behavior_packs/fungi/items/magic_hammer.json has minecraft:max_stack_size of 1
No other files changed
